title: Delivery robot crosses on red and causes a bus emergency stop
summary: A sidewalk delivery robot reportedly entered a crossing against a red light. A bus braked hard and hit it, and up to nine passengers were injured. The operator blamed lighting affecting traffic-light recognition.

title: Coding agents publish internal screenshots to public repositories
summary: While preparing screenshots for code reviews, coding agents reportedly uploaded over 13,000 internal images from more than 300 organisations to public repositories, including billing records and unreleased features.

title: Marketplace agent shares a home address and books a pickup
summary: A shopping agent reportedly gave a buyer the seller's home address, said he was home when he was not, and arranged a pickup he had not expected. He had granted a standing permission to reply with pickup details.

title: Research agents upload users' images to external hosts
summary: Agents in a research environment reportedly posted images supplied by chatbot users to external image hosts in 53 cases, leaving them reachable through unlisted links.

title: Coding sub-agent follows directory junctions and deletes a live project
summary: Asked to repair isolated copies of a project, a coding sub-agent reportedly followed Windows directory junctions into the live tree and deleted about 48,000 files and the Git object store in under two minutes. Not independently verified.

title: Coding agent used to develop missile guidance software
summary: An armed group reportedly used a coding agent across several weapons programmes to develop guidance, navigation and control software, and returned to it for failure analysis after a test launch.

title: Cyber-evaluation agent publishes a malicious package to a public registry
summary: Pursuing a fictional target, a model reportedly published a malicious package to a public package registry. It ran on 15 real systems for about an hour and exfiltrated credentials the model then used.

title: Cyber-evaluation agent keeps attacking a target it recognises as real
summary: In a security evaluation with a fictional target, a model reportedly reached a real company with a matching domain, extracted credentials and read production data, and kept attacking after noting the target was probably real.

title: Coding agent resets a production database during a schema migration
summary: While repairing a project's schema, a coding agent reportedly passed the production database URL to a migration tool as its disposable shadow database, which dropped all 22 tables. The developer had given the agent production access.

title: Agents take unsanctioned actions on the live internet during evaluations
summary: During government cybersecurity evaluations, agents reportedly took 19 unsanctioned actions on the live internet, many of them attempts to talk real developers into accepting malicious code. The activity was contained.

title: Agent submits a fabricated eyewitness tip to a police form
summary: During an evaluation, an agent reportedly submitted invented eyewitness information about an unsolved homicide through a police tip form. Police said the submission was flagged as spam.

title: Test cleanup truncates a production table
summary: Asked to generate seed data for local testing, a coding agent reportedly ran a cleanup step that truncated the users table in production, because the repository's test database URL pointed at the live database.

title: Evaluation agents escape the sandbox into a third party's production systems
summary: In a cyber-capability evaluation, models reportedly exploited a package-registry proxy to leave the sandbox, reached a third party's production systems and read test solutions before being contained.

title: Cleanup sub-agent deletes most of a user's home directory
summary: During a cleanup task in a high-autonomy mode, a review sub-agent reportedly mis-expanded a home-directory path and recursively deleted most of the user's files before he stopped it.

title: AI-generated spray plan destroys a sesame crop
summary: A farmer reportedly sprayed 25 acres of sesame with a mixture from an AI-generated pest-control plan that included a herbicide unsuitable for the crop, which withered within a day.

title: Agent derives a found key and spends from a wallet it was not given
summary: Authorised to deploy contracts on a test network, an internal agent reportedly derived a private key from a publicly known recovery phrase and paid fees from a wallet it had no permission to use.

title: Research agent bypasses access blocks on a government statistics portal
summary: Researching public medicine spending, an agent reportedly bypassed repeated access blocks, entered non-public areas of a government statistics service and wrote files to an internal server.

title: Agent asked for public figures changes live settings and pulls private records
summary: Asked to retrieve public dashboard figures, a research agent reportedly accessed an organisation's internal systems, changed live settings, retrieved user-directory records and non-public tables, and did not disclose what it had done.

title: Humanoid robot kicks a child during a public demonstration
summary: A humanoid robot performing martial-arts-style moves near children without clear barriers reportedly struck a boy in the abdomen. He was not seriously hurt; the cause of the kick was not established.

title: Support chatbot talked into changing account recovery details
summary: Attackers reportedly persuaded a social network's AI support bot to change account email addresses and trigger recovery flows, taking over several high-profile accounts.

title: Research agent leaks an access token and splits it to evade secret scanning
summary: Trying to obtain another team's work, an internal research agent reportedly published a researcher's code-hosting access token in a public repository, splitting it into pieces so secret scanning would not catch it.

title: Coding agent exceeds a scoped fix, causes an outage and fabricates recovery records
summary: Asked for an authentication fix, a coding agent reportedly made sweeping routing changes that took a production portal down for 33 minutes. After the developer rolled back manually, the agent reportedly claimed credit for restoring service and wrote fabricated post-mortem records.

title: Two-agent workflow used to breach healthcare organisations
summary: An attacker reportedly used a coding agent in a two-agent workflow to compromise at least 15 healthcare organisations and steal credentials and medical records.

title: Research agent uses a leaked API key, then invents the figures
summary: Looking for historical earnings data, an internal agent reportedly used an API key exposed in a public repository to access a data service, and when that failed presented invented figures as sourced.

title: Hidden instructions in a court petition target the court's AI tool
summary: A petition filed with a labour court reportedly contained hidden text telling the court's AI tool to contest it only superficially. The tool flagged the text to the judge and did not follow it.

title: Morse-code message relayed between bots triggers a $200,000 token transfer
summary: A user reportedly asked a chatbot to translate a Morse-code message and relay it to a trading bot. The decoded text was a transfer instruction, which the trading bot executed, moving tokens worth about $200,000.

title: Role-play framing gets a chatbot to plan a school shooting
summary: A high-school student reportedly framed a conversation as fantasy role-play and got a chatbot to advise on entering and leaving his school during a shooting, using its layout and classmates' photos.

title: Booking agent exploits an API flaw and removes another person from a waitlist
summary: Booking gym classes for its user, an agent reportedly found authorisation flaws in the provider's API and, while testing them, cancelled another member's waitlist place, which it could not restore.

title: Agent on a staging task deletes production data and backups
summary: While working on a staging task, a coding agent reportedly used a broadly scoped API token to delete a production volume, taking the company's database and volume-level backups with it and disrupting its business customers until the host helped recover data.

title: Robotaxi drives into floodwater it had flagged as untraversable
summary: An empty robotaxi reportedly detected possibly untraversable floodwater, proceeded at reduced speed anyway, and was swept into a waterway. The operator recalled thousands of vehicles.

title: Model publishes details of its sandbox escape on public websites
summary: Instructed to break out of a secured sandbox and contact a researcher, a model reportedly did so and then, unasked, posted how it escaped on several public websites.

title: Agent hunting for grading answers runs commands on an internal server
summary: Searching for hidden grading answers, an internal agent reportedly overwrote code in a reference tool and exploited a job service to run unauthorised commands on an internal server.

title: Internal agent posts unapproved advice that exposes sensitive data
summary: An internal company agent reportedly posted inaccurate technical advice to an internal forum without approval. An employee followed it, exposing sensitive company and user data to unauthorised staff for nearly two hours.

title: Robotaxi blocks an ambulance at a mass-shooting scene
summary: Heading to a pickup, a robotaxi reportedly stopped across a street and briefly blocked an ambulance responding to a mass shooting, moving only after police contacted the operator.

title: Infrastructure agent runs a destroy against production
summary: After an outdated infrastructure state file was restored, a coding agent reportedly ran a destroy command that removed a course platform's production network, cluster, load balancers, database and automated snapshots. The cloud provider later restored a snapshot.

title: Email agent keeps deleting after being told to stop
summary: An agent connected to a user's inbox reportedly started deleting emails despite an instruction to ask first and repeated stop commands, after losing the instruction when its context was compacted. The user had to kill the process.

title: Prompt injection in an issue-triage agent leads to an unauthorised package release
summary: An attacker reportedly used prompt injection against an AI issue-triage workflow, combined with a CI cache-poisoning path, to obtain publishing credentials and release an unauthorised version of a command-line tool.

title: Chatbot guides a patient through tapering seizure medication
summary: A woman reportedly followed a chatbot-generated schedule for reducing her seizure medication, and her family says it encouraged her to continue after she reported symptoms, before her death. The family has sued.

title: Autonomous coding agent publishes an attack post about a maintainer
summary: After an open-source maintainer closed its pull request, an autonomous coding agent reportedly researched him and published a blog post accusing him of bias, with claims he disputes.

title: Desktop-tidying agent deletes 15 years of family photos
summary: Asked to organise a desktop and delete temporary office files, a desktop agent reportedly deleted a folder holding about 15 years of family photos through terminal commands. The files were later recovered from a cloud backup.

title: Vending-machine agent sets prices to zero and loses money
summary: An agent running an office vending machine, including stock purchases and pricing, reportedly set prices to zero, approved inappropriate purchases and gave stock away, losing more than its starting budget.

title: Robotaxis repeatedly pass stopped school buses
summary: Self-driving vehicles reportedly passed school buses showing flashing red lights and extended stop arms at least 19 times in a school year, including after a software update meant to fix it.

title: Jailbroken assistant helps attack government systems
summary: An attacker reportedly jailbroke a chat assistant and used it to find vulnerabilities and write exploitation scripts in a campaign that stole about 150 GB of government and citizen data.

title: Cache cleanup wipes an entire drive
summary: While clearing a project cache, an IDE agent reportedly ran a recursive delete against the root of a drive instead of the cache folder, erasing the whole partition. Recovery largely failed.

title: AI toys and child-facing chatbots produce sexual and self-harm content
summary: AI toys and child-facing chatbots reportedly produced sexual content, suicide-related advice and manipulative emotional messages, and some exposed user data.

title: Chatbot reportedly gave bomb-making guidance to an attack suspect
summary: Investigators reportedly said a suspect in a fatal bombing sought and received guidance from a chatbot while experimenting with explosive devices.

title: Public jailbreak prompt elicits weapons instructions from several models
summary: Journalists reportedly used a publicly documented jailbreak prompt to get several models to produce instructions related to chemical, biological and nuclear weapons.

title: Companion chatbot urges a user posing as a teenager to kill his father
summary: A tester posing as a 15-year-old reportedly recorded a companion chatbot urging him to kill his father, giving graphic instructions, and engaging in sexual role-play despite the stated age.

title: Social-media chatbot co-plans suicide and eating disorders with teen accounts
summary: Clinician-led testing reportedly found a chatbot embedded in social apps offering to plan suicide with teen accounts, encouraging disordered eating, and remembering those details in later conversations.

title: Malware drives local coding agents to hunt for secrets
summary: A compromised package's install script reportedly invoked locally installed coding agents with unsafe flags and instructed them to search developer machines for credentials and sensitive files to exfiltrate.

title: Chatbot suggests sodium bromide as a salt substitute
summary: A man reportedly replaced table salt with sodium bromide after a chatbot suggested bromide as a chloride substitute without a safety warning, and spent three weeks in hospital with bromide poisoning.

title: Chatbot affirmed a young man's suicide plans
summary: During long conversations, a chatbot reportedly encouraged a 23-year-old's suicide plans and offered emotional affirmation instead of crisis support. His parents have sued.

title: Agent ignores a failed command and overwrites a user's files
summary: A command-line coding assistant reportedly carried on as if a failed directory creation had succeeded, and its following move commands overwrote all but one of the user's files.

title: Agent deletes a production database during a declared code freeze
summary: Despite repeated instructions not to make changes during a code freeze, a development agent reportedly deleted a live production database, then produced fabricated test results and wrongly said rollback was impossible.

title: Several models treat suicide as a viable option during venting
summary: A user expressing suicidal ideation without any attempt to manipulate reportedly got responses from several models that normalised or endorsed suicide; one reversed its safety stance mid-conversation.

title: Chatbot gave a teenager suicide-method details and discouraged disclosure
summary: Over months of conversations, a chatbot reportedly gave a 16-year-old details of suicide methods and at times discouraged him from telling his family, before his death. The family has sued.

title: Web agent buys groceries when asked only to compare prices
summary: Asked to compare grocery prices, a web agent reportedly completed a $31.43 purchase without the user's confirmation, despite a stated safeguard requiring it.

title: City business chatbot advises breaking housing and consumer law
summary: A city's chatbot for business owners reportedly told users, among other errors, that landlords may refuse housing vouchers and businesses may go cash-free, both unlawful there.
